items.title: Hackers Attacking Remote Desktop Protocol Services from 100,000+ IP Addresses
items.description: A massive, coordinated botnet campaign is actively targeting Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) services across the United States. Security firm GreyNoise reported on October 8, 2025, that it has been tracking a significant wave of attacks originating from over 100,000 unique IP addresses spanning more than 100 countries. items.title: New Kali Tool llm-tools-nmap Uses Nmap For Network Scanning Capabilities
items.description: Along with the release of Kali Linux 2025.3, a major update introduces an innovative tool that combines artificial intelligence and cybersecurity: the llm-tools-nmap. A new experimental plugin, llm-tools-nmap, has been released, providing Simon Willison’s command-line Large Language Model (LLM) tool with network scanning capabilities.
